colors.guidelines: Use Iris AI ONLY for meaningful AI states (e.g., AI Video Generation, AI Enhance, Agent Trace). Golden Hour is the primary interaction color.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous whitespace, editorial margins. Use Tailwind scales p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento-style asymmetric grids for experiences, strict high-density grids for studio workspaces.

loop_strip.description: Signature brand device. A continuous marque or horizontal flex of the closed loop.
loop_strip.styling: Font-technical or small font-body, uppercase, tracking-widest, separated by dots or arrows. Subtle opacity (50%) for inactive steps, Golden Hour for active step.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D6A85F] text-[#171714] hover:bg-[#c2954e] font-body rounded-full px-6 py-3 transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: border border-[#171714]/20 dark:border-[#F7F3EA]/20 text-current hover:bg-[#171714]/5 dark:hover:bg-[#F7F3EA]/5 rounded-full px-6 py-3
buttons.ai_action: bg-[#7267A8] text-[#FFFDF8] hover:bg-[#5f5591] rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(114,103,168,0.4)]

plan_cards.styling: bg-[#FFFDF8] border border-[#171714]/10 rounded-2xl p-8. Recommended tier gets Golden Hour border and subtle drop shadow.
plan_cards.usage_meters: JetBrains Mono for numbers. Progress bar uses Golden Hour for standard usage, Sage Film for optimal/under-limit, red/warning if nearing limit.

experience_cards.styling: Editorial layout. Large image taking up 70% of card height, 30% text content below. Subtle borders, no heavy shadows. Images must have a slight vignette or overlay to ensure text contrast if text is placed over them (bg-black/30 maximum).

video_monitor.styling: Dark cinematic workspace component. Pure Lumiere Ink background for the player area to enhance contrast. Sharp corners, minimalistic controls. Use Iris AI for 'Enhance' or 'AI Edit' buttons overlay.

music_picker.styling: List view with waveforms. Play button on left, track name in Playfair Display, duration in JetBrains Mono, 'Apply' button on right. Hover state highlights row in subtle Golden Hour tint.

nav_header.styling: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F3EA]/70 (light) or bg-[#171714]/70 (dark). Includes Logo, Navigation links, Language toggle (ES/EN), and Avatar menu.

motion.light_to_dark_transition: Cinematic 'projection room' transition. When moving from a light route (Home) to a dark route (Editing Studio), use a dramatic background color fade (duration: 0.8s, ease: 'easeInOut') simulating lights dimming in a theater.
motion.hover_states: Subtle y-axis lift (-translate-y-1) and opacity shifts. Never use 'transition-all', specify 'transition-transform transition-opacity transition-colors'.

hero_landscape.description: Majestic Milford Sound fjord in New Zealand

ai_generation_state.description: Captivating mist over a Transylvanian mountain peak

experience_luxury_yacht.description: A white yacht sails past buildings framed by trees

experience_resort.description: Luxury resort pools overlooking a serene lake

avatar_editorial.description: Close up editorial portrait of blonde hair person

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Golden Hour must have dark text on it. Iris AI must have light text on it.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion' by disabling the projection room transition.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT introduce new colors outside the Master Specification.
Maintain the editorial, luxury-travel personality. Use generous whitespace (p-12, p-16) and avoid cramped SaaS layouts.
Ensure Profile/Account screens contain ZERO video players. Do NOT render videos inside the user profile.
Implement the INTENT -> STORY -> DIRECT ... loop strip prominently on the Landing/Home pages.
Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for metrics, usage numbers, and technical readouts. Use Playfair Display for big impactful headings.
Implement the 'projection room' transition when crossing between light (e.g., Home) and dark (e.g., Studio) routes.
Iris AI color (#7267A8) MUST ONLY be used for AI features (generation, enhancement, Agent Trace).
Do NOT use emojis in the UI. Keep it professional, cinematic, and premium.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
MUST NOT center align the app container in css.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
